description: This file defines API routes for authentication and user role management in a FastAPI web application, including registration, login, retrieving current user info, listing roles, creating roles, and attaching roles to users.

classes.name: APIRouter
classes.description: FastAPI router object used to define and group authentication-related API endpoints.

methods.name: UserOut _user_to_out(user: User)
methods.description: Converts a User model instance into a UserOut schema, including roles.

methods.name: UserOut register(payload: RegisterRequest, session: AsyncSession = Depends(get_db_session))
methods.description: Endpoint to register a new user, assign default 'customer' role, with error handling for duplicate emails.

methods.name: TokenResponse login(payload: LoginRequest, session: AsyncSession = Depends(get_db_session))
methods.description: Endpoint to authenticate user credentials and generate a JWT token.

methods.name: UserOut me(current_user: User = Depends(get_current_user), session: AsyncSession = Depends(get_db_session))
methods.description: Returns the current authenticated user's details, loading roles if necessary.

methods.name: list[RoleOut] list_roles( _: User = Depends(get_current_user), session: AsyncSession = Depends(get_db_session) )
methods.description: Returns a list of all available roles.

methods.name: RoleOut create_role( payload: RoleOut, _: User = Depends(require_roles(["admin"])), session: AsyncSession = Depends(get_db_session), )
methods.description: Creates a new role; accessible to admin users.

methods.name: UserOut attach_role( user_id: int, payload: AttachRoleRequest, _: User = Depends(require_roles(["admin"])), session: AsyncSession = Depends(get_db_session), )
methods.description: Attaches an existing role to a specified user; accessible to admins.
